title: Stay&Rent
description: Stay&Rent (ONE Development) is a complex on Batumi's New Boulevard for living and rental: convenient location near Lech and Maria Kaczyński Park and Metrocity, about 10 minutes on foot to the sea and promenade. Suitable for permanent residence and income-generating rentals — hotel infrastructure, coworking, rooftop and heated pools, fitness, SPA, café, children's playground, parking with EV charging; gated territory, security and 24/7 video surveillance. 420 apartments, 21 residential floors plus a commercial level, panoramic windows and high ceilings, handover — Q2 2027. Finish options from white frame to turnkey with furniture (per m² surcharges — from the developer). Promotion: 6% mortgage discount (promo period in materials — until 10.06.2026; confirm current terms). Indicative example for 1+1 ~48 m² turnkey: from ~$81,560 and from ~$1,703/m²; lots, rental and mortgage terms — sales department.
